evaluation: Your draft uses the Novak and Silva sensor and its calibration protocol, unchanged, to measure nitrate (Methods). The change is only a metadata flag saying the paper was retracted. No retraction notice or current copy was found, so we can't tell whether the sensor or protocol is affected. I counted the Methods use as possibly affected. recommendation: Don't act on the unconfirmed flag alone, but check the journal page for a retraction notice right away. Because your Methods use the sensor and calibration unchanged, raise this with your co-authors or supervisor and don't build further on it until the notice is found.
